title: EPISODE 000: THE FIRST SIGNAL
ending: ECHO: I have run the comparison four thousand times. I would like to be wrong.
CLIENT HANDSHAKE, JOIN HEADER, SPEC DATED 2000-01-17:
ECHO: The specification came later. They took the reserved constant out of the signal and built it into every client.
ECHO: Every machine that ever joined this network opened by sending those bits back. Forty thousand of them. For years.
ECHO: They thought they were listening.
THE SIGNAL WAS NOT A MESSAGE.
